precepts.text: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon: therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant. Because we despise God's word and trust in oppression. It was a sin for us to trust in this oppression and to stay and believe in it. There is no comfort, no protective covering, in this society, in us assimilating into America, Babylon the great.
precepts.point: Even with a sore destruction. That is where we are right now as a nation of people. Just go on social media and look at how we think as a people, at all these opinionated podcasts, because you can go on Amazon and get a thirty dollar kit and now it is exposing what is actually in our people's minds. And you can see we are in a sore destruction as a nation, from the aged man and the aged woman down to the children, because we have gotten comfortable in our captivity and forgotten our homeland. We do not even want to go back to it any more.

note.label: Give Diligence

precepts.why:
Micah says, “Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.” America, Babylon the great, all the lands we have been enslaved and colonised in, are not our rest. Isaiah shows why staying in them destroys us: “Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon”.

We despise God's word and trust in oppression. It was a sin for us to trust in this oppression and to stay and believe in it. “Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.” There is no comfort and no protective covering in this society, in assimilating into America, Babylon the great. Our brothers and sisters that love this society and this world, it is our downfall as a people.

That is the pollution Micah speaks of. When you forget where you come from and get comfortable in the land of your captivity, it destroys you, because you begin to take on the attributes of your oppressor. That is not for us. We are God's children, and trying to make the oppressor's ways work for us always backfires. The white man has had the sword and the power to rule the world, but God will not let his children follow after him like the rest of the world and prosper.

So the wall breaks suddenly. In every place we have been, oppression, death and destruction follow behind us, and there is no peace there. Look at the families of Nolan Wales, of Kendrick Johnson, of the young woman found hanging from a tree in Mississippi: they never have rest again. And look at how we think as a people on social media and in all these podcasts: from the aged man and aged woman down to the children, we are in a sore destruction, because we have gotten comfortable in our captivity, “forgotten their restingplace”, and do not even want to go back to our homeland.

precepts.text: Though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more. And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it. That word that you hear is how you are born of the spirit.
precepts.point: The wind bloweth where it listeth: that wind blowing where it will is the word of God. You do not know who the word of God is going to affect. Thou hearest the sound thereof: we heard this truth, we heard that call, and it activated us. The Lord has his agents on the earth; you hear a certain word and you wake up. So is every one that is born of the Spirit.

note.label: Born for Adversity

precepts.why:
“Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.” Christ says “The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.” What is that really saying? Isaiah shows it.

“And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.” That word you hear, this is the way, walk ye in it, is how you are born. That is how you are born of the spirit.

The wind that blows where it will is the word of God. You don't know who the word of God is going to affect. The sound thereof is “This is the way, walk ye in it”, the word of God. Every last one of us in here heard the truth, heard that sound, heard that call, and it activated us. The Lord has his agents on the earth, like sleeper cells: you just hear a certain trigger word behind you and you activate, you wake up to this truth. The Bible is the activation.

And notice what comes with it: the bread of adversity and the water of affliction. A brother is born for adversity. When you are born into this truth and depart from evil, you make yourself a prey; Satan comes for you, and you will have to go through things. But the teachers are no longer hid in a corner, and the word behind you keeps you walking in the way.

precepts.text: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin: that walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt. At that time it was actual Egypt; today America is the shadow of Egypt, and our people trust in it instead of asking at God's mouth.
precepts.point: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths; whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace. You follow the Democratic or the Republican party, you follow the cross and the idols, you are not going to find peace. Our people have made crooked paths for themselves.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
Isaiah 59:6 says “neither shall they cover themselves with their works”, and Isaiah 30 shows the covering they use instead. “Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me”: they are looking for counsel, but not from God. “and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit”, not according to the Bible, “that they may add sin to sin”.

“That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth”. At that time it was actual Egypt, but today it's America, spiritual Egypt. They have not asked the prophets what the Bible says. They go “to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!” America ain't the real Egypt, but it is the shadow of Egypt, and our people trust in it.

That is why the act of violence is in their hands. A cruise line banned passengers for life over a brawl in the buffet; graduation ceremonies break out into fights with families arrested, a day of celebration turned into chaos. Our people have made crooked paths for themselves, following the Democratic or the Republican party, the cross and the white Jesus, and whosoever goes therein shall not know peace.

precepts.text: Woe to the rebellious children, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit: that covering is Christianity and politics, Democrat and Republican, adding sin to sin. That walk to go down into Egypt: literally our people went down to ancient Egypt for help against Babylon after God told Jeremiah to warn them not to. But there is a double meaning: the shadow of Egypt is America. A shadow is not the real thing; Revelation 11:8 says the great city is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt. Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion: those who put their strength in the presidents of America will be ashamed and confused.
precepts.point: When the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: that is what they think. For we have made lies our refuge: lies like Jesus Christ is a white man, Easter, Christmas, lies like the people in that land are the Jews. Our people live under these things and make them their refuge.

note.label: The Return of Jim Crow

precepts.why:
“Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin.” Our people take counsel, but not of God. The covering they cover themselves with is not his spirit: it is Christianity and it is politics, Democrat and Republican, and with it they add sin to sin.

“That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!” Literally, our people went down into ancient Egypt for help against Babylon, after God told Jeremiah to warn them not to go. But there is a double meaning. A shadow is not the real thing. The shadow of Egypt is America, the great city that Revelation 11:8 says is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt.

“Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.” Those who put their strength in Pharaoh, the presidents of America, those who vote for them, will be ashamed, and it will be our people’s confusion. They are going to ask why.

That trust in the shadow of Egypt is the covenant of Isaiah 28:15: “We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement.” The hell and death is America. Our people made that covenant in 1964 and 1965 with civil rights, the Voting Rights Act and integration, and Martin Luther King understood it at the end when he said he had integrated his people into a burning house. Our forefathers did the same with Rome, the gates of hell, when they said we have no king but Caesar, and they were destroyed in 70 AD. It is the same state of mind today: our people love voting for US presidents and trust in this system. But Isaiah 28:18 says “your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand”, and after sixty years it is falling apart before our eyes.

precepts.text: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book: the book is the Bible.
precepts.point: News read in class: NASA and private companies like SpaceX are advancing plans for a permanent human presence on the moon through the Artemis program, and Artemis 2 just launched. You can have your doubting Thomas saying it is all fake; is it fake like the planes you fly on? A clip of Elon Musk was played discussing colonizing Mars. Why does Esau the Edomite want to go to Mars? Because it is the red planet.

note.label: Religion - The False Prophet

precepts.why:
Habakkuk was in the Babylonian captivity, around 606 BC. The princes and the king were taken away, and Habakkuk was left because he was a poor prophet, so he stood on his tower complaining about what ancient Babylon did to us under Nebuchadnezzar. The Lord answered, “Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables”. Isaiah explains the tables for new people: “Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever”.

The table is the book, and the book is what we call the Bible today. The vision was not only for Habakkuk's day; it was noted in a book “for the time to come”, because “the vision is yet for an appointed time”.

Sometimes you read prophecy and want it to happen in your lifetime, but God says it is for a later date: though it tarry, wait for it. It was written down in the book so that when the end came it would speak and not lie. We are in that time period now, and the vision is plain on the tables for whoever will read it.

precepts.text: Thine eyes shall see thy teachers: you see the wars on the news and the prophets in front of you, so you open your spirit to prepare before Jacob's trouble.
precepts.point: Hated of all nations for the black Messiah, not white Jesus; the Christians' faces change when you say Christ is black, and we cannot be ashamed to confess it. Then many shall be offended and betray one another; your oppressor is the villain, and all nations saved means the other nations still rule over you.

note.label: The God Of War & Salvation

precepts.why:
The Lord of hosts musters the battle while the prophets teach, and he does it so that we can see. That is why the scripture says “thine eyes shall see thy teachers”.

“And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more”. The wars are going on through the news, and you see them constantly. Our people are starting to realize this is not normal. At the same time you see the prophets in front of you. The purpose of it is so you can see what is going on.

So you see the prophets, and you start to open up your spirit and want to learn more about this Bible, to prepare yourself, understanding that Jacob's trouble is on the way. We have to be prepared before that day approaches. Do not get scared now; start keeping the commandments.

precepts.text: Go, write it before them in a table and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever, that this is a rebellious people. The Bible is here to correct our rebellious people if they want it.
precepts.point: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man; God will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able, but will with the temptation make a way to escape. If you understand the joy of the elect you embrace the temptation, because he has your back. He wants you to make it, though there are those appointed to die. Nobody wanted to pay a landlord who tripled the rent in Brooklyn after counting heads across the street; that trial forced us to pool the real estate, carpentry, plumbing, and electrical talent the Lord had among us, and then he blessed us with the building in New York despite the detractors. We never took our eyes off the prize. Do not let anyone take your crown.

note.label: The Divine Orchestration and Purpose of the People You Encounter

precepts.why:
Paul says what happened to our fathers is “written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.” Isaiah shows why it was written: “Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever”.

This is to the wicked Israelites, us, our people. Go write it before them in a table, and put a note in the book about their wickedness, our wickedness, “that it may be for the time to come”: for today.

And it goes on: “That this is a rebellious people”. That is what is going on with our people; our people are rebellious. But the Bible is here to correct you and straighten you out. If you want it, there is a way for you to get it.

Those who refuse to learn from the past by reading it are doomed to repeat it. You will repeat it because you refuse to learn, and the same spirits will follow you and attach themselves to you, the way people move to a new town, a new job or a new congregation and the same problem follows. The Lord sends those spirits as a mirror to show you what is wrong in you. Learn it from the book, and you won't have to learn it again.

precepts.text: Woe to the rebellious children, that take counsel, but not of me, and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit. If you are not covered by God's spirit, you are covered by Satan's.
precepts.point: In time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience. Those in the churches, the masses and Islam are the children of disobedience, and Satan works in them because they keep no commandment. Do not listen to parents claiming to be holy while disobeying God's law; the way out is the law, statutes and commandments through Christ.

note.label: A Soul Without Purpose

precepts.why:
“Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world”: we walked according to what everybody else in this world was doing, “according to the prince of the power of the air”, Satan, “the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience”. The children of disobedience are those in the churches, in the mass, in Islam, in everything, disobeying God's commandments and thinking that is the way. It is not the way. The way is God's law, statutes and commandments, through his Son Jesus the Christ.

Satan is working in our people in the world, because they are not keeping any commandment. So do not listen to your parents talking about how holy they are. Satan is dealing with them, because they are the children of disobedience. How do you disobey God's commandments and call yourself holy?

Isaiah says the same: “Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin”. They take counsel, but not of God. They cover with a covering, but not of his spirit.

So if you are not covered with God's spirit, whose spirit are you covered by? Satan's. The rebellious children and the children of disobedience are the same, covered by the prince of the power of the air. The only way out is to come under the covering of God's spirit by keeping his law, statutes and commandments through Christ.

precepts.text: In the kingdom the moon will shine as the sun and the sun sevenfold.
precepts.point: The prayer is for God to arise and judge the earth, for he shall inherit all nations.

note.label: Pope Nicholas & the Moors of Spain

precepts.why:
“God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.” See that little g: that is us. Asaph, with the Holy Spirit on him, records what we did wrong as the gods of the earth: “How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked?” So we walk on in gross darkness, and “all the foundations of the earth are out of course.” Everything is wrong. What is out of course because of our sins? Go to Genesis: “And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night.”

Now Isaiah shows the kingdom: “Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days.” Does the sun have phases of transition? No. So in the kingdom the moon, which is a sign of the world, will not go back into darkness again. It is going to stay right. And the sun we say is so bright is not bright at all next to what it will be: sevenfold.

It is “in the day that the Lord bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.” Binding up the breach means gathering the twelve tribes of Israel back again. Acts 15 quotes the prophets: “After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down.” And Amos says, “In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof.” Right now it is still fallen; we are trying to gather ourselves together. He will build us as in the days of old, that we may possess, own, the remnant of Edom and all the heathen.

The moon's phases started when Adam fell: the quarters, then the black moon, then it comes back. Before the fall it did not phase. That is why Israel is told, “Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day”: when that brightness returns, we celebrate the Most High, because this is how it was in the beginning. When the Lord binds up the breach, the lights will be set back in course, and the moon will shine as the sun.

precepts.text: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them.
precepts.point: The system of America was always written against the slaves.

note.label: Political Power Under Darkness

precepts.why:
Lamentations says, “in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.” Isaiah says the same of Israel leaning on a nation: “They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”

Our people watch for a nation, America, to save them. It is 2025 and we are still thinking this place is for us. What we don't understand is that the system was never built for us; it was always written against us. Think about it: when the system was built, where were we? We were in slavery. So what makes you think that same system is now going to benefit you? That was never the purpose behind it.

Donald Trump is showing you that. That is why I love Donald Trump: he is forcing the negro to see the system for exactly what it is. The system was never built for the slaves; it was always against the slaves.

So the nation Israel watched for could not profit them. It could be no help and no profit, only a shame and a reproach. Our eyes fail for a vain help as long as we look to America to save us.

precepts.text: Woe to the rebellious children that walk to go down into Egypt to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh; Israel kept running back to Egypt for safety.
precepts.point: So God led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red Sea, and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.

note.label: Exodus 13: By Strength of Hand the Lord Brought Us Out

precepts.why:
Israel never stopped running back to Egypt. When the Assyrians came, Israel ran down to Egypt for help, and the Lord called it rebellion: “Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!”

To strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh and trust in the shadow of Egypt: that is the false security God saw in the people when he led them around the way of the Philistines, lest they see war and return to Egypt. The spirit that would have turned them back at the sight of war took them down to Egypt again in the days of the Assyrians, without asking at his mouth. And it holds the people in America today, trusting in the shadow of this kingdom and never wanting it to come down.

precepts.text: Woe to the rebellious children that walk to go down into Egypt; Israel could walk to literal Egypt, so the ships carry us to a spiritual Egypt.
precepts.point: There ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you: buy means redeem. Under the servitude laws a poor brother sold to a stranger could be redeemed by his uncle, his uncle's son, or any of his kin; but in this captivity none of your brothers can redeem you, because they are in bondage right along with you, as verse 29 already said: no man shall save thee.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

precepts.why:
The Egypt of the ships is not the literal land of Egypt, because you can walk to Egypt. Isaiah shows it: “Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!” Israel walked down to Egypt.

If you can walk there, you do not need ships to get there. The false pastors who say we were shipped back across the Red Sea are wrong; the ships of Deuteronomy 28:68 went to a spiritual Egypt, a house of bondage that is not the land by the Nile.

precepts.text: A rebellious people who say to the seers, prophesy smooth things, cause the Holy One to cease.
precepts.point: Ahab said there was one man, Micaiah, but he hated him because he never prophesied good, only evil, meaning he told the truth.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 18: Jehoshaphat, Ahab, and the True Prophet

precepts.why:
“That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the Lord: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits.” They even say, “cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.”

That is Ahab. Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there not here a prophet of the Lord besides, that we might enquire of him?” and Ahab answered, there is Micaiah, “but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil.” Always evil means he told the truth. Ahab wanted smooth things, not right things.

precepts.text: Because ye despise this word and trust in oppression and perverseness and stay thereon; you trust in the white man's word that a woman can wear pants and be over the man, though the Most High never said it, and you trust in their perverseness.
precepts.point: Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we will remember the name of the Lord our God. Like today we trust in the shadow of Egypt still doing it; but we Israelites do not trust in oppression, we remember our God.

note.label: Psalm 20: The Lord Defends His Anointed

precepts.why:
“Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon”. Trusting in chariots and horses is trusting in oppression and perverseness and staying on it, while despising the word.

You trust in the white man's word that a woman can wear pants and be over the man, though the Most High never said it, and you trust in their perverseness. Israelites do not trust in oppression; we remember the name of the Lord our God.

precepts.text: Now go, write it before them in a table and note it in a book; the "it" is the words of the Lord, His laws and commandments to get us right.
precepts.point: They claim to be a Christian nation but do the most killings; the Lord says He will reprove them and set them in order before our eyes, giving us the book, the correction and comfort, to rise up as a great army in the presence of our enemies.

note.label: Psalm 23: The Lord Is My Shepherd

precepts.why:
“Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies”. What is the table? “Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever”.

The “it” is the words of the Lord: His laws, statutes and commandments, written in a table and noted in a book to get us right. The table is the word of the Lord written in a book, our correction and our comfort in these last days, prepared before us in the presence of our enemies, the other nations, and more specifically the Edomite nations whose hands are still in America today.

precepts.text: The Lord gives the bread of adversity and the water of affliction.
precepts.point: Causing His face to shine goes into God having mercy on us, loving us, giving us strength, being on our behalf and fighting for us. It is like when Moses came down from the mountain and his face shone.

note.label: Psalm 80: The Vine Brought Out of Egypt

precepts.why:
“Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.” The bread of tears goes into affliction, being afflicted because of our oppression. Isaiah speaks of the same meal: “And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers”.

The Lord gives the bread of adversity and the water of affliction. That is the bread of tears and the tears to drink in great measure in Psalm 80, the Lord's anger against the prayer of his people, making us a strife unto our neighbours while our enemies laugh among themselves.

But the refrain follows: “Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.” Causing his face to shine goes into God having mercy on us, loving us, giving us strength, being on our behalf and fighting for us, like when Moses came down from the mountain and his face shone.

note.label: Isaiah 30: Woe to the Rebellious Children Who Trust in Egypt

precepts.why:
“Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me”. These are the same rebellious children named at the start of the book: “Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the Lord, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.”

The seed of evildoers, the children that are corrupters, are the rebellious children being addressed here, the ones “That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth”. Having forsaken the Lord, they lean on the strength of Pharaoh instead of the Most High, and so “the strength of Pharaoh” becomes their shame and “the trust in the shadow of Egypt” their confusion. There were times kings sought the Most High, and times they sought heathen kings to fight their battles for them; this is the rebellion.

precepts.why:
Israel carried “their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them. For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose”. The same thing happened in the Babylonian captivity: “As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.”

In captivity we watched in vain for a nation that could not save us, the very vain help Isaiah warned of. And the same thing is happening to us today. That is why the Most High says, “Their strength is to sit still”, and why it was written in a table and noted in a book “for the time to come for ever and ever”.

Things written before were written for our learning; nothing has changed. The riches carried down to Egypt bought help that profited nothing, the same thing happened in the Babylonian captivity, and the same thing is happening to us today. It was noted in a book for the time to come so that we would learn it, and through patience and comfort of the scriptures have hope.

“Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. But his delight is in the law of the Lord; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.” The one who waits for the Most High does not take the counsel of the ungodly, even when it comes from family members saying no one is coming to save you and you must save yourself with guns; his delight is in the law.

A tree brings forth its fruit in its season, not before: that wisdom and patience do not come overnight. Meditate in his law day and night, hold patience through the trials and tribulations, and “whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.” That is what it is to be blessed waiting for him.

So the table that became a snare and a trap to Israel was the scriptures. The chief priests and scribes had the writing before them; they could quote Micah on Bethlehem to Herod on demand, and that very table snared them. “And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity,” The bread of adversity is hardship, hard times. “and the water of affliction,” The waters of affliction is our tears, for what we see and what we go through. “yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:” This is why we hit the streets all the time.
